sources.locator: user decision 2026-11-18: progress-based stop plus safety caps (3 fixes per TC, 5 rounds), script plus guide, auto-fix product failures, repro test required when a suite exists
user decision 2026-11-19 (grimbang C run): a TC split in two with the user's OK — the new ready TC joins the running loop through tc-change

actions.title: Ask the loop what to do next
outputs: one JSON line with action and TC list

actions.title: Classify a failing TC
preconditions: the TC failed in the current round
outputs: failure entry with class and fingerprint

actions.title: Record a product fix
preconditions: the TC failure is classified product

test_cases.title: The first round runs every ready TC that is not skipped
preconditions: a TC file with 3 ready TCs and 1 needs-decision TC

expected.text: The output action is run_round
The output tcs list holds exactly the 2 ready TCs that are not skipped

test_cases.title: A failure with no class blocks the next round
preconditions: round 1 recorded one FAIL line and no classify call

expected.text: The output action is classify
The output tcs list holds the failing TC id

test_cases.title: After a fix only the fixed and affected TCs run again
preconditions: round 1: TC A failed, TC B and C passed
fix recorded for A with --affected B

expected.text: The output action is run_round
The output tcs list equals [A, B]

test_cases.title: A case-class failure goes to the user and is not run again
preconditions: A classified case with a note

expected.text: The output ask_user list holds A with class case
A is not in the output tcs list

test_cases.title: A fix record with no --test is refused
preconditions: TC A failed and is classified product

steps.goal: Run tc-fix-loop.js fix --tc A --files src/x.js without --test

expected.text: The exit code is 2
findings.json has no fix entry for A

test_cases.title: The same failure fingerprint after a fix stops that TC
preconditions: TC A failed in round 1 at expected index 1
A failed again in round 2 at expected index 1 only

expected.text: The output ask_user list holds A with reason stuck
A is not in the output tcs list

test_cases.title: A sixth round is refused
preconditions: 5 rounds opened with the default limits

steps.goal: Run tc-fix-loop.js round --run-id with a new id

expected.text: The exit code is 2
tc-fix-loop.js next prints action cap_reached

test_cases.title: A round is refused after TC text changed without an approved change
preconditions: one expected text in the TC file was edited afterwards

steps.goal: Run tc-fix-loop.js round --run-id with a new id

expected.text: The exit code is 2
The error output names the changed TC id

test_cases.title: When reruns pass, one full round runs before done
preconditions: round 2 ran only A and it passed

expected.text: The output action is final_regression
The output tcs list equals [A, B]

test_cases.title: A TC that passed before and fails now is marked as a regression

expected.text: The output regressions list holds B

test_cases.title: A new ready TC added with the user's OK joins the loop
preconditions: a new ready TC added to the TC file

steps.goal: Run tc-fix-loop.js tc-change for the new TC

expected.text: next lists the new TC among the TCs to run
